scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic identities, analytic positivity/properness and LaSalle proof. Computation checks necessary identities but is not an infinite proof. Bibliographic comparisons are scientific and do not certify priority.
scientific_limitations: Only the classical 3D Rössler flow at fixed a<=0 and b,c>0 with initial z>=0 is treated; the exact total dissipation formula requires initial z>0. No positive-a dynamics, negative-height basin, parameter degeneracies or uniform global convergence rate are asserted. Bibliographic priority remains subject to unindexed results and incomplete access to some later papers.
title: Global entropy stabilization of the Rössler flow with nonpositive feedback
